title: Ensemble Toolchain Config
description: Schema for both the project-level (.ensemble/toolchain.yaml) and user-level ($XDG_CONFIG_HOME/ensemble/toolchain.yaml) toolchain adapter-selection files (TRD-2026-8d825f54 TRD-003, PRD REQ-009). Each of the 14 toolchain categories may optionally select an adapter by name; a config file need not set every category.

timeouts.description: Per-project adapter call bounds in ms by timeout class (TRD-2026-6995dc96 TRD-028, PRD REQ-017). Overrides each adapter manifest's own `timeouts`.

adapters.description: Per-adapter overrides keyed by adapter id (e.g. `adapters: { jira: { statusMap: {...}, statusNames: {...} } }`). Lets a repository extend an adapter's status vocabulary without duplicating the adapter.

statusMap.description: Provider status name -> normalized status (open|in_progress|closed). Read direction: how a provider's own status name is normalized.

statusNames.description: Normalized status -> provider status name. Write direction: which provider status name is written for a normalized status.
